settings.headline: Will you
settings.subtitle: Please reply by April 15, 2027. One reply covers everyone on your invitation.

settings.headline: Kindly reply
settings.intro: Fill this in once for everyone on your invitation. You can always email us if plans change.
settings.aside: Tell us about allergies, accessibility needs or anything else in the note. We read every reply ourselves.

steps.title: We read your reply
steps.text: It comes straight to us and stays private. Nobody else sees it.

steps.title: Book your hotel
steps.text: Room blocks close in May. The codes are on the travel page.

steps.title: A final note in May
steps.text: We'll email shuttle times and anything else you need to know a few weeks before.
